title: Attach input and aggregate capacity conformance

cases.summary: Runs attach-input/all (first-paint parity, admission before delivery, the exact output-wait marker, the operator lease, bounded shared storage with an accounted overflow gap, and client-side checkpoint plus tail reconstruction on a normal and an overflowed terminal against uninterrupted VTs), capacity/sixteen (the exact 16-PTY profile: admissions within 100 ms, exit waits armed before the exits, exact deliveries) and attach/resize (a resize applied while input is queued). The 100 ms event bound, ordered geometry events and the session budget are declared.

Runs attach-input/adversarial: revoked queued write, impossible credit, stale epoch, fake status text, refused paste, overflow cursor_expired and floor resume, stalled child with an ineffective Escape, the per-terminal input queue refusing input_overflow inside its budget, an over-cap argv, two writers' submissions delivered whole and in admission order, and checkpoint_inexact on a paint inside an open sequence.
